name: sleipnir-bench
about: The recipe of the benchmark suite and, under lock, what building it gave. bench/build.sh builds it; bench/build.sh --check compares a rebuild with the lock. budget_caps bound what a single-agent task may use, whatever its generator derived (swarm tasks keep theirs). Tags: smoke (minutes, about 8 tasks), core (the regular suite), swarm (composite tasks for a manager and workers), long (memory tasks that overflow a small context window).
